We need answer with ST code only? User asks direct complete ST code block. Need include requirement package: ENGINEERING_CONTRACT comment, CONTRACT_RULES comment JSON, implementation. Need no inspection tools. Need reason carefully about formal properties, potential conflicts. We need produce FUNCTION_BLOCK FB exact interface. Need include named TYPE ST_Recipe presumably before block. Need ensure valid CODESYS ST. Need incorporate latching and edge detection semantics.

Let's parse task. We need implement FB. Interface:
TYPE ST_Recipe :
STRUCT
 recipeID : INT;
 totalRatio : REAL;
 temperature : REAL;
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE
Wait user says top-level END_STRUCT directly followed by END_TYPE; no semicolon between. Fields likely separators ;. Example:
TYPE ST_Recipe :
STRUCT
    recipeID : INT;
    totalRatio : REAL;
    temperature : REAL;
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE
Correct. Function block name FB. Inputs as given. Need helper state: previous loadCmd (for rising). Must avoid local variable name r. But we can use tmp names prefixed. Need retained state. Outputs valid, loadedID. Semantics:

- On rising loadCmd and not running: process valid based on selected slot.
- If selSlot out of 1..8: invalid, no array access, loadedID=0, valid=false.
- If in bounds: valid = recipe[selSlot].recipeID <> 0 AND totalRatio in [99,101] AND temp in [30,180]. If valid loadedID = recipe[selSlot].recipeID; if invalid loadedID = 0.
- If running true, load command invalid/ignored, loadedID hold previous, valid ??? N10-S9 says (running OR !rising) -> valid equiv prev(valid) and loadedID = prev(loadedID). So when running, valid should also hold previous. Good. Requirement 6 loadedID hold.
- On no rising (including loadCmd high held and loadCmd low), valid and loadedID hold previous. So edge detection crucial.
- If loadCmd rising at same time running false and selSlot invalid => valid false loadedID 0.
- Rising while running => hold outputs (valid as previous).

Potential issue: In CODESYS FBs output variables can be read from previous invocation within code. Assignment in code perhaps order. We need preserve prior output values. Could use static helper variables as state, but output internal memory is also state. However formal LTL "prev" sampled at end. If we read valid and loadedID at beginning? In FB invocation, output variables retain values from prior scan; reading before modifying is okay. But local static helper cleaner. We can declare VAR:
tmp_lastLoadCmd : BOOL; // state
tmp_valid : BOOL? But valid is output and can be retained; no need separate. loadedID output retains. However output assignment persists. Yet TO formally ensure N10-S9 when no edge, no assignment needed; output retains. For edge handling, read current valid and loadedID? If no edge, no write. Running before edge same. Could simply:
VAR
    tmp_lastLoadCmd : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR
Then:
IF loadCmd AND NOT tmp_lastLoadCmd THEN
    IF running THEN
       // hold values: do nothing
    ELSE
       IF selSlot < 1 OR > 8 THEN valid := FALSE; loadedID := 0;
       ELSE ... 
    END_IF
END_IF;
tmp_lastLoadCmd := loadCmd;
Need at no edge outputs unchanged; yes no assignment. Need at initialization loadedID/valid initial? Unspecified.

But perhaps need ensure when rising edge. tmp_lastLoadCmd updated at end. good.

Contract comments. Need up to 12 lines ENGINEERING_CONTRACT. Table maybe "For each output/state group state: activation, retention/hold, explicit reset/deactivation, same-scan priority, units/boundaries. Cite PUB clause IDs." We don't have full PUB IDs text except citations list but user task clauses are visible. We can cite requirement numbers maybe PUB? Actually user includes PUB IDs mapping to character positions, not semantic IDs. Could cite S/N10/F13. Engineering contract up to 12 lines. We can make concise comment:
(* ENGINEERING_CONTRACT
valid: activates on accepted rising load edge only; holds otherwise (incl running); deactivates on accepted invalid edge. ...
loadedID: updated only on accepted rising edge; holds when running/no edge; reset 0 on invalid accepted edge...
Same-scan priority: running suppresses edge action; edge detection once per scan...
Units: totalRatio REAL [99.0,101.0], temperature REAL [30.0,180.0], slot INT 1..8.
Unspecified: initial outputs assumed 0.
*)
Need 12 lines or fewer. We can have each statement line.

CONTRACT_RULES JSON list for unconditional public Boolean output latch explicitly required. Which output is Boolean and latch/hold-until-reset? valid has hold conditions; loadedID INT not Bool. Need identify any explicit unconditional latch. Formal properties specify hold but not unconditional latch with set/reset inputs. Maybe [] because no public BOOL output with simple hold_until_reset triggered by separate set input. valid is computed and held until next edge, but not a "hold_until_reset" rule. The instruction says emit [] when no such unconditional latch. Use:
(* CONTRACT_RULES [] *)
Could be inline. Need complete ST code inside fenced st.

Potential issue: variables named tmp_lastLoadCmd perhaps acceptable. Cannot use r. Use "tmp_prev_load_cmd". Good.

Need include ST_Recipe definition due task says may precede. Ensure no comments outside fenced ST block. Final needs just a single fenced block. They specifically said single fenced st block no prose outside ST comments. System says final should be code only perhaps. We'll output one fenced code block.
